note: The previous commit adds 17 identifier real-query rows and records the reference on the unchanged engine. This change: a definition hit is rendered at its declaration line instead of the first line mentioning the name (display only); definition credit goes only to source files of a parsed language, and on otherwise equal evidence source sorts before documents and data instead of letting the path decide; a receiver.member query also finds the member's declaration as definition evidence, a file whose path names the receiver first; an identifier query whose name occurs in no indexed file answers 'not found' with up to five nearest names and their locations instead of a fuzzy ranking. Other query shapes keep their exact evidence. The same train also carries changes that do not move in-project rows: other-project (external path) identifier sweeps and saved-index freshness checks, subc-protocol 0.28 with tool-provider v1 selected at bind, the subc-client 0.20 close reasons in the bridge, a shared cache for the fake LSP test helper, and the regenerated tool-provider catalog fixture.
